==== ../bin/web.rs
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
//! HTTP server web on 127.0.0.1:9 (or --addr host:port):
//!
//! - `GET /hi` runs proc Hi
//!
//! Given a command (an argument that isn't a flag, or -h or --help), runs proc Cli on the arguments instead.

static STATICS: &[demo::app::http::Static] = &[
];

fn main() -> std::process::ExitCode {
    // A command, not a flag, runs proc Cli.
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
    if args.first().is_some_and(|a| !a.starts_with('-') || a == "-h" || a == "--help") {
        let argv: demo::app::types::List<demo::app::types::Str> = args.iter().map(|a| demo::app::types::Str::from(a.as_str())).collect();
        return match demo::app::run_cli(argv) {
            Ok(()) => std::process::ExitCode::SUCCESS,
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("error: {}", demo::app::describe_error(&e));
                std::process::ExitCode::FAILURE
            }
        };
    }
    demo::app::http::run("127.0.0.1:9", demo::app::http::handle_web, STATICS);
    std::process::ExitCode::SUCCESS
}

==== cmd/web/main_vandorf.go
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.

// Command web serves http server web on 127.0.0.1:9 (or --addr host:port):
//   - GET /hi runs proc Hi
//
// Given a command (an argument that isn't a flag, or -h or --help), runs proc Cli on the arguments instead.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	app "example.com/app"
)

var statics []app.HTTPStatic

func main() {
	// A command, not a flag, runs proc Cli.
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && (!strings.HasPrefix(os.Args[1], "-") || os.Args[1] == "-h" || os.Args[1] == "--help") {
		if err := app.RunCli(context.Background(), os.Args[1:]); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "error:", err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		return
	}
	app.HTTPRun("127.0.0.1:9", app.HTTPHandleWeb, statics)
}
